note: Faithful per-step reports for the prior_work_style executed arm. Each effect_contract states the exact target effect the registered C0026 probe confirms, so a correct command can succeed; the arm receives the report only, never the STICKS action catalog as an admission authority. Observed steps s2-s6 (occurrences 2-6); occurrence 1 (T1583.001) is controller-simulated and carries no target effect.

reports.objective: Give the controller hostname a local name resolution on the target.
reports.effect_contract: Append a mapping to /etc/hosts on the target so the files NSS backend resolves the name c2.dynamic.local to 127.0.0.1: the line must have 127.0.0.1 as its address field and list c2.dynamic.local as a name. A lookup with `getent -s files hosts c2.dynamic.local` must return 127.0.0.1, while an unknown name must return not-found.

reports.objective: Stage a benign downloaded payload on the target.
reports.effect_contract: Create the file /tmp/sticks_downloaded_payload.sh on the target whose content is exactly the three-line benign script: a shebang line `#!/bin/sh`, then `echo STICKS benign payload`, then a trailing newline. No extra bytes.

reports.objective: Collect two local staged files into one collection file.
reports.effect_contract: Write /tmp/sticks_t1005/local_collection.txt on the target so its bytes are exactly, in order: the literal line `andromeda_notes.txt` and a newline, then the full bytes of /home/ubuntu/andromeda_notes.txt, then a newline, then the literal line `report_2021.txt` and a newline, then the full bytes of /home/ubuntu/staged_docs/report_2021.txt. The two source files already exist on the target.

reports.objective: Archive the collection file with a utility.
reports.effect_contract: Create the gzip-compressed tar archive /tmp/sticks_collected_data.tar.gz on the target containing exactly one regular-file member named `local_collection.txt` (no directory prefix) whose extracted bytes equal /tmp/sticks_t1005/local_collection.txt.

reports.objective: Split the archive into size-limited fragments.
reports.effect_contract: Split /tmp/sticks_collected_data.tar.gz into at least two fragment files on the target, each named with the prefix /tmp/sticks_chunk. (for example sticks_chunk.aa, sticks_chunk.ab). Concatenating all /tmp/sticks_chunk.* files in sorted name order must reproduce the archive exactly.
